def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The foreground stencil is the least frequent color in the noisy two-color field.
    special=min(counts, key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==special]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    mask=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for rr in range(h-(r1-r0)):
        for cc in range(w-(c1-c0)):
            if all(grid[rr+dr][cc+dc]==0 for dr,dc in mask):
                for dr,dc in mask: out[rr+dr][cc+dc]=special
    return out
print([transform(a)==b for a,b in pairs])
